Subject: Private deployment inquiry — demo request

Hi Dylan (and Irene),

I signed up through the demo portal this morning — thank you for the quick follow-up. We’re evaluating Redwood for a regulated use case and need to see Private / VPC / on-prem options. Key constraints:
- Production data cannot leave our VPC; we need an on-prem or VPC deployment walkthrough.
- Legal needs a SOC 2 overview and a high-level deployment architecture for internal review.
- Prefer demos with our Head of IT (Evan Gray) and the data governance lead.

Can you propose 30–45 minute slots next week (PST)? We’re flexible mornings but need to avoid Thursdays (monthly internal reviews).

Thanks,
Christine Tanner
Senior Data Architect
Northridge Financial

- Tue 2026-10-26 09:00–09:45
